programs.title: Road absurdities
programs.desc: In Szczecin, viewers will see one of the exits from the A6 motorway, which looks more like an ordinary intersection than a collision-free junction.The presenters will also check why, after the reconstruction of the road in Gryfino, cars park in green areas, why there is a railway crossing in Poznań that requires speaking into a loudspeaker and where the intriguing "start-up" for cyclists came from.In Łódź, Kamil and Krzysiek will assess the validity of spending public money on bus lights in a place where no buses run and will show the pointless painting on the road.Viewers will also hear about problems with maintaining a new sidewalk in Łęczno, a large parking lot in the middle of nowhere in Czyżów and a pole on the Piaseczno bicycle path.

programs.title: Road absurdities
programs.desc: In Warsaw, viewers will see a very long barrier and sewage manholes encroaching on parking spaces, in Poznań, a senseless traffic light, in Łódź, a section of the road has been closed causing alternating traffic, and in Krakow, a pancake roundabout and a combination of signs exempting scrap metal scrappers from the speed limit.Kamil and Krzysiek will check what the rubber curbs blocking the emergency lane do in Tychy, why there is a ban on bicycles on the Gliwice bicycle path and how to explain the existence of a traffic-free area limiting the entrance to the church parking lot in Kalwaria Zebrzydowska.
